title: Creative Demo Addins Bank
description: Create a bank of visually and conceptually interesting demo add-ins that prove install → visible effect → uninstall, without requiring executable add-in code.
rationale: We need demos that sell the Addins model without dragging core into provider-specific logic or risky runtime execution.
success_criteria: Each demo add-in produces an obvious operator-visible change
All demo add-ins are static contributions (no code execution)
notes: Focus on low-gravity capabilities: themes, tone, docs, roles, commands (declarative).

title: Narrative and Memory Packs
description: Add-ins that make the system feel alive: storybook timelines, decision ledgers, lore, and runbooks.
rationale: High demo impact, low security risk: mostly markdown + schemas + UI rendering.
success_criteria: Narrative content is indexed and searchable
Operator can browse content by add-in source
No add-in content can crash the UI
notes: All rendering must be safe markdown (no arbitrary HTML execution).

title: Operator UX Magic Packs
description: Add-ins that transform the feel of the operator console through declarative configuration: tone, lenses, accessibility, language.
rationale: Demonstrates extensibility without touching kernel logic and without needing a backlog provider model.
success_criteria: Operator can enable/disable UX packs safely
UX changes are obvious and reversible
Errors are actionable and do not break baseline UI
notes: No backlog/provider assumptions. Pure UI contributions and settings.

title: Trust and Governance Demo Packs
description: Add-ins that demonstrate provenance, audit trails, and policy visibility (without enforcement).
rationale: Build public trust: show signatures/digests and auditable lifecycle without allowing execution.
success_criteria: Operator can see installed add-ins with digest and source
Audit trail is viewable and exportable
Policy visibility works without enforcing behaviour
notes: No security theatre: call things 'advisory' until enforced.

title: Agent Interaction Demo Packs
description: Add-ins that add agent roles, prompt packs, and declarative slash commands without executing add-in code.
rationale: This is the DaemonCore sweet spot: adding behaviour through safe configuration and curated prompts.
success_criteria: New roles/prompts appear and are selectable
Removing the add-in cleanly removes capabilities
notes: Commands must route to existing built-in handlers/templates only.

title: Operator Personality Pack
description: Swap UI microcopy for different operator tones (Calm SRE, Audit Mode, Startup Chaos) via a static language bundle.
acceptance_criteria: Tone packs can be enabled/disabled from Settings
UI strings clearly indicate which pack is active
Fallback to default strings if pack missing
notes: Keep it fun but not cringe. Public repo friendly.

title: Cognitive Lens Pack
description: Add lens presets (Agile/Ops/Research) that alter what the operator sees (fields, filters, labels) without changing underlying data.
acceptance_criteria: Operator can select a lens and see the UI reframe instantly
Lens definitions are loaded from add-in contributions
Invalid lens payload fails safely with a clear error
notes: No backlog semantics required: lenses can apply to any page with metadata.

title: Project Storybook Pack
description: Add a Storybook tab that renders narrative chapters from markdown entries (project origin, milestones, lessons).
acceptance_criteria: Storybook entries are discoverable and searchable
Entries show attribution to source add-in
Markdown rendering is safe and consistent
notes: Huge demo impact with minimal risk.

title: Decision Ledger Pack
description: Add ADR-lite decision records viewer with tags and search, sourced from add-in markdown.
acceptance_criteria: Decision records list and detail views render correctly
notes: Keep ADR template generic and useful.

title: Daemon Lore Pack
description: Optional lore pages + subtle easter-eggs that build brand identity without affecting system behaviour.
acceptance_criteria: Lore pages are opt-in and clearly marked as non-functional
No lore content appears unless enabled
notes: Keep it tasteful; avoid cringe fanfic vibes.

title: Trust Signal Pack
description: Display add-in digest, source, version and a simple trust badge with explainers (advisory only).
acceptance_criteria: Operator can view digest/source for each installed add-in
UI copy clearly explains what is and isn't verified
No sensitive data in public logs/UI
notes: Public-friendly: no claims of security beyond what's implemented.

title: Audit Trail Viewer Pack
description: Add a UI viewer for add-in lifecycle events: install/enable/disable/uninstall.
acceptance_criteria: Events are viewable in UI with timestamps
Events include add-in id/version and action
notes: Events can be stored as a simple append-only file initially.

title: Policy Visibility Pack
description: Show declared project constraints (no enforcement) as banners/tiles and in a dedicated Policies view.
acceptance_criteria: Constraints are clearly marked as advisory
Policies list shows source add-in attribution
notes: This is a killer demo: feels 'governed' without enforcement risk.

title: Accessibility Pack
description: Add accessibility presets (font scale, contrast tokens) and an a11y checklist panel.
acceptance_criteria: Operator can enable a11y preset and see immediate change
Checklist panel can be installed/removed safely
No permanent change if add-in is removed
notes: Public-friendly and genuinely useful.

title: Language Pack (EN-GB + Pirate)
description: Add localisation bundles for UI strings: EN-GB baseline plus a fun Pirate pack for demo flair.
acceptance_criteria: Operator can switch language pack from Settings
Fallback to default strings for missing keys
Pack is attributed to source add-in
notes: Keep the Pirate pack short and optional. No offensive language.

title: Agent Role Pack (Public Demo Roles)
description: Add demo agent roles and profiles (SRE, Product, Security) as selectable options.
acceptance_criteria: Roles appear in UI with clear descriptions
Selecting a role persists, with safe fallback if removed
Roles are loaded from add-in contributions
notes: Do not include any private/company-specific roles in public repo.

title: Prompt Skill Pack (Triage/Review/Write)
description: Add curated prompt packs for common workflows, selectable in UI.
acceptance_criteria: Skill prompts appear in UI and are attributable
Prompts render safely and are editable by project owner
Removing the add-in removes the skills cleanly
notes: Public-friendly: generic prompts only.

title: Slash Command Pack (Declarative)
description: Add declarative slash commands that route to existing built-in handlers/templates (no code in add-in).
acceptance_criteria: Commands route only to pre-approved internal actions
notes: This is the safe path: commands are metadata, execution is core-owned.

title: Demo Addins Gallery
description: A gallery page that showcases installed demo add-ins with screenshots and verification steps.
acceptance_criteria: Gallery lists installed add-ins with metadata
Gallery includes verification steps per add-in
notes: This makes demos smooth and story-driven.

title: Project Onboarding Questline Pack
description: Install a guided onboarding questline (checklists + tips) visible in the operator console.
acceptance_criteria: Questline appears after install and can be dismissed
Quest steps are stored as static templates
Questline content is attributed to add-in source
notes: Feels like a product, not a framework demo.

title: Validate tone pack payloads
story: As an operator, I want tone packs to validate so that broken packs fail safely.
description: Define a schema for microcopy packs and validate on install/load with safe fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid pack does not break UI
Clear error message shown in logs/UI
implementation_hints: Use schema validation with strict key checks.

title: Apply tone pack in Operator UI
story: As an operator, I want to switch tone packs so that the console matches the vibe of my environment.
description: Expose tone pack selection in Settings and apply strings dynamically with attribution.
acceptance_criteria: Tone pack selection visible in UI
implementation_hints: Keep it reversible. No hard dependencies.

title: Lens preset schema and validation
story: As an operator, I want lens definitions to validate so that invalid lenses can't break the UI.
description: Define lens preset schema (filters, labels, visible fields) and validate.

title: Lens selection experience
story: As an operator, I want to switch lenses so that the console presents information in the way I need.
description: Add lens selector and show which lens is active.
acceptance_criteria: Disable/uninstall lens pack reverts to default
implementation_hints: No data mutation; UI framing only.

title: Storybook entry schema and safe rendering
story: As an operator, I want storybook entries to render safely so that content packs can't execute arbitrary markup.
description: Define schema for storybook entries and render markdown safely with sanitisation rules.
acceptance_criteria: Index list loads and links correctly
implementation_hints: Use a safe markdown renderer; strip unsafe HTML.

title: Storybook browsing UI
story: As an operator, I want a storybook view so that project history is human-readable and easy to explore.
description: Add navigation entry and browsing UI for storybook chapters.
acceptance_criteria: Storybook tab appears when pack installed
Chapters list and detail view work
implementation_hints: Make it obvious it's add-in provided.

title: ADR-lite schema and indexing
story: As an operator, I want decision records indexed so that I can find why a decision was made.
description: Schema for ADR entries, plus indexing by tags/date.
implementation_hints: Keep ADR template simple and public-safe.

title: Decision ledger UI
story: As an operator, I want to browse decision records so that I can understand rationale quickly.
description: List + detail view, attribution, search.
implementation_hints: Make it demo-friendly with sample decisions.

title: Trust signals schema + data sourcing
story: As an operator, I want trust signals to be consistent so that I can understand provenance at a glance.
description: Define trust-signal schema and ensure it can be derived from registry + installed state safely.
acceptance_criteria: Trust signals load without extra permissions
implementation_hints: Never claim verification you don't implement.

title: Trust signal UI badges
story: As an operator, I want trust badges so that I can see which add-ins are verified or unknown.
description: Add UI badges and explainer modals/tooltips.

title: Role pack schema + validation
story: As an operator, I want role packs validated so that invalid roles don't break agent UI.
description: Define role/profile schema and validate; include safe fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid roles are ignored with warnings
implementation_hints: No private company roles in public repo.

title: Role selection UI
story: As an operator, I want to select a role so that the assistant responds in the right mode.
description: Expose roles, select, persist, and attribute to source add-in.
acceptance_criteria: Removal of add-in falls back safely
implementation_hints: Make the demo roles fun but professional.

title: Slash command schema + routing restrictions
story: As a platform admin, I want slash commands constrained so that add-ins can't execute arbitrary actions.
description: Define command schema and enforce routing only to pre-approved internal handlers/templates.
implementation_hints: No executable scripts, ever, in this phase.

title: Slash command discovery UI
story: As an operator, I want to discover available commands so that I can learn what add-ins add.
description: Command help/palette page with grouping by add-in source.
implementation_hints: Make it feel like a product feature.

title: Gallery schema + add-in metadata ingestion
story: As an operator, I want the add-ins gallery to validate its cards so that broken metadata doesn't break the demo.
description: Define schema for gallery cards: title, description, screenshots, verification steps.

title: Gallery UI
story: As an operator, I want a gallery so that demos are smooth and I can quickly show what add-ins do.
description: Gallery page listing installed demo add-ins with verify buttons/steps.
implementation_hints: Make it slick: good demo is a product.

title: Define tone pack schema (v1)
description: Create JSON schema for tone packs (microcopy overrides) and include example bundles (Calm SRE, Audit Mode, Startup Chaos).
prompt:
# Define tone pack schema (v1)

## Goal
Create a JSON schema for microcopy override packs and add 2-3 example packs.

## Guardrails
- Static contributions only
- Safe fallback behaviour

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Schema validates example packs
- [ ] Missing keys fall back to defaults
- [ ] Tests cover invalid payload

title: Implement tone pack loader + validation
description: Load tone packs from installed add-ins, validate against schema, and expose to UI selection logic with safe fallback.
prompt:
# Implement tone pack loader + validation

## Goal
Load validated tone packs from add-in contributions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Invalid packs don't break UI
- [ ] Clear error messages
- [ ] Unit tests added

title: Add Settings UI for tone selection
description: Add UI control to select tone pack; show active pack and source add-in; revert on disable/uninstall.
prompt:
# Add Settings UI for tone selection

## Goal
Make tone pack selection obvious and reversible.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Active pack shown with attribution
- [ ] Default fallback works
- [ ] No regressions

title: Define lens preset schema (v1)
description: Create schema for lens presets (labels, filters, visible fields) and provide Agile/Ops/Research examples.
prompt:
# Define lens preset schema (v1)

## Goal
Create a lens schema and examples.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Lenses validate
- [ ] Bad lens fails safely

title: Build lens selector UI
description: Add lens selector, show active lens, and apply lens framing to supported UI sections.
prompt:
# Build lens selector UI

## Goal
Provide lens switching as a demo.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Selector works
- [ ] Attribution shown

## Goal
Ship a fun, public-safe storybook pack.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] 5-8 chapters
- [ ] Safe markdown
